change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Stream2Sea, LLC는 최종제품의 분석·미생물 출하시험과 품질부서 승인 전에 OTC 제품을 출하했으며, 원료 확인시험과 공급업체 COA 검증도 누락했다. 또한 공용 설비의 세척 밸리데이션·기록이 부족해 교차오염 가능성 평가와 시험실·원료관리·세척관리 절차의 전면 보완이 필요하다.

impact_summary.value: 완제품 출하 전 시험과 원료 확인이 미흡해 제품이 정해진 품질 기준에 적합한지 뒷받침할 자료가 부족하며, CGMP 미준수로 의약품이 불순물 의약품으로 간주됩니다. 교차오염 위험과 규제·법적 조치 가능성도 제기됩니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).
Without adequate testing, you lack basic data to support that each drug product batch conforms to appropriate specifications before release.

affected_work.value: Stream2Sea의 OTC 의약품 제조·시험·출하, 원료 및 구성품 관리와 공급업체 적격성 평가, 설비 세척·세척 밸리데이션 업무가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm failed to perform adequate analytical and microbiological release testing for each batch of your over the counter (OTC) drug products prior to distribution.
Your firm failed to perform identification testing on raw materials and components including APIs prior to use in your OTC drug products.

You failed to adequately validate your cleaning procedures to ensure the removal of API residue and cleaning agents, as well as control of potential microbial contamination for your non-dedicated manufacturing equipment.

recommendation.value: 기관은 실험실 및 자재 관리 체계를 독립적으로 평가하고 시정·효과평가 계획, 시험 규격·방법·절차, 각 구성품 로트의 확인시험 및 공급업체 COA 신뢰성 검증 자료를 제출해야 합니다. 세척 밸리데이션 개선, 최악조건 평가, 변경관리 단계, 세척 효과의 회고적 평가를 제시하고, CGMP 자격을 갖춘 컨설턴트 활용을 강하게 권고받았습니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: A comprehensive, independent assessment of your laboratory practices, procedures, methods, equipment, documentation, and analyst competencies. Based on this review, provide a detailed plan to remediate and evaluate the effectiveness of your laboratory system.
In addition, include a commitment to always conduct at least one specific identity test for each incoming component lot.

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, we strongly recommend that your firm engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.

practical_review.scope: 확보한 본문 기준 · 첨부 및 미확보 페이지는 제외 · 자동 추출
